name: North Carolina

fees.note: $12 for over-width. Single trip permit valid 10 calendar days.

Threshold modeled as overall length over 73' (20' tractor + legal 53' trailer), since the engine only knows the overall length. $12 for over-length (threshold here = 53' trailer/load length; single vehicle 40', other combinations 60').
$3 per 1,000 lb over 132,000 lb (tiers assume each started 1,000 lb counts; listed to 300,000 lb = $504, heavier loads not extended).
$100 non-refundable superload application fee (engineering study). Charged once per application - if the load is also 17'+ wide this and the width line double-count.
$100 non-refundable superload application fee (17'+ wide). Charged once - see weight line.

escorts.when: Over 12' wide, on two-lane and other roads
Over 12' wide, on interstates and freeways

police.text: 1 police escort. Over 16' wide: three escorts total, one of which must be NC State Highway Patrol

restrictions.text: Sunrise to sunset, Monday through Sunday, unless the permit states otherwise. Loads over 16' wide or over 14' high: written application at least 2 business days before the move.

Over-width/height/length loads and loads over 112,000 lb: no travel from noon the weekday before until noon the weekday after Independence Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas (2026: Jul 3 noon-Jul 6 noon; Nov 25 noon-Nov 27 noon; Dec 24 noon-Dec 28 noon).
Over 12' wide: no travel 7-9 am and 4-6 pm within 10 miles of the city limits of Charlotte, Raleigh, Durham and Chapel Hill.
Continuous 24/7 travel only up to 112,000 lb and 10' wide with no other over-dimension; superloads (> 132,000 lb) never continuous.
No movement with visibility under 500 ft or unsafe conditions; permitted vehicles of the same company/origin must travel at least 2 miles apart.

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the weekday before to noon the weekday after
No travel from noon the weekday before to noon the weekday after

notes: Superloads (> 132,000 lb, 17'+ wide, or axles over 20k steer / 25k single / 50k tandem / 60k tridem / 68k 4+ group): apply at least 10 business days ahead for bridge review.
Max single-trip width: ST-1 (2019) says 16'11 in; rule 19A NCAC 02D .0602 (2019) says 15' with superload above 15'; SL-6 (2020) puts superload at 17'. Verify current practice.
Over 105' overall needs Central Permit Office approval after route review (19A NCAC 02D .0602(a)(5)); ST-1 says no overall length limit for single trips.
No general route-survey threshold found (only for 16'-wide mobile homes on certain routes); permittee is responsible for vertical clearances.
Additional escorts may be required at the issuing agent's discretion; NC escorts must hold NC (or reciprocal) escort certification.
